mostWorthwhile.text: Seating the pink tile gave the frame a distinctive, easily described addition.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second arch repeated the first fitting, although the instruction and result were clear.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprising happened; the flip clearly changed the frame's orientation.

arbitrary.text: The battery fitting had a clear stated purpose, though its connection to the tile was not yet apparent.

continue.text: Probably not personally: the instructions were clear, but the mostly single-option steps and static completed frame offered limited payoff in text. The artwork and touch experience cannot be judged here.
